fields.title: Flat Mode
fields.description: removes glass, shadows, and borders for a flat minimal look

fields.title: Content Card Border Style
fields.description: border treatment for the main editor card: glass (default — solid background with inset bevel + ring like callout cards), asymmetric (the original gradient with two corners highlighted), or full border (symmetric highlight)

fields.title: Floating View Header
fields.description: the back/breadcrumb/action bar row floats over the note card instead of sitting above it, giving the note more vertical space

fields.title: Floating Header — Hover to Reveal
fields.description: when floating header is enabled, hides the bar until you hover over the note card (requires floating view header to be on)

fields.title: Status Bar — Hover to Reveal
fields.description: hides the status bar until you hover near the bottom of the window

fields.title: Horizontal Settings Nav
fields.description: replaces the left sidebar with a horizontal scrolling nav strip across the top of the settings pane

fields.title: Flat Active Tab Style
fields.description: reverts the active tab to the flat inset highlight style instead of the sculpted neumorphic shadow

fields.title: Hide Tab Control Pill Borders
fields.description: removes borders and background from the new-tab, tab-list, and sidebar toggle buttons at the edge of the tab bar

fields.title: Reduce Motion
fields.description: disables all animations and transitions — for accessibility or preference. the OS-level prefers-reduced-motion setting is also respected automatically without this toggle

fields.title: New-Tab Empty State (Gradient + Lobster)
fields.description: applies the "working edits" style empty state when no tabs are open

fields.title: Halo Gradient
fields.description: enable a wip background animation inspired by soft grainy gradients and angel numbers

fields.title: Enable Custom Workspace Background
fields.description: ⚠️ only supported with the 'abaddon glass' dark subtheme. for a local image or base64: drop ultra-lobster-bg.css (from theme snippets/) + your image into your obsidian snippets folder and enable the snippet. for a web url: paste below. both can be active — url field takes priority.

fields.title: Custom Background Web URL
fields.description: takes priority over the snippet. paste a direct image link wrapped in url("https://..."). leave as 'none' to use the snippet instead.

fields.title: Blur Status Bar Pills
fields.description: blurs the background of the statusbar pill option

fields.title: Disable Canvas Blur
fields.description: removes the backdrop-filter blur effect from canvas nodes

fields.title: Island Pill Status Bar
fields.description: separates statusbar items into pills

fields.title: Properties Card
fields.description: wraps the frontmatter properties block in a glass slab with inset value wells (off by default for a minimal layout)

fields.title: Properties Key Style
fields.description: key label treatment: blueprint is the minimal default (floating accent bar on hover), margin note adds a › pointer, underline reveal animates an accent line from center

fields.title: Neon Glass Property Tags
fields.description: restores the glowing accent-coloured pill style for multi-select property tags

fields.title: Inline Property Tags
fields.description: makes property tags look like standard inline wireframe tags

fields.title: Active Line Popup Animation
fields.description: adds a popup scale animation when switching lines (works with any active line highlight style)

fields.title: Glass Chevrons
fields.description: replaces the default dot indicators with glass bubble chevrons

fields.title: QuickAdd Input Style
fields.description: box (default) — subtle filled pill. underline — bare bottom border only. underline + gradient — bottom border with an accent gradient wash on focus

fields.title: Text Scale
fields.description: 🚨 must be a whole / decimal number such as 1 or 1.1. further scale can be changed via slider in appearance

fields.title: Accent Bold & Italic
fields.description: applies distinct accent colors to bold and italic text

fields.title: Serif Italic
fields.description: renders italic text in a serif typeface

fields.title: Italic Font
fields.description: typeface used for em / italic text when Serif Italic is on (falls back to --font-serif if empty)

fields.title: Disable Auto-Hyphenation
fields.description: turns off automatic hyphenation on paragraphs (on by default)

fields.title: Print / PDF — Show Link URLs
fields.description: when printing or exporting to PDF, append the URL after external links

fields.title: Size
fields.description: in em

fields.title: Weight
fields.description: numeric font weight e.g. 300 400 500 600 700

fields.title: Shimmer
fields.description: animates the note title with a flowing accent-colour shimmer gradient

fields.title: Tabular Numbers
fields.description: all digits use tabular (monospace) figures across the whole note — good for data-heavy vaults

fields.title: Stylistic Alternates
fields.description: enables font-feature-settings: "ss01" for fonts that ship optical variants (Inter, Recursive, Fraunces)

fields.title: Disable Ligatures
fields.description: turns off common and contextual ligatures for maximum readability on dense code-heavy notes

fields.title: Custom Line Width
fields.description: apply opinionated line widths — 80ch editor, 68ch reading. override below.

fields.title: Custom Body Weight
fields.description: enable body font weight control (uses the slider below)

fields.title: Internal Link Style
fields.description: chip (default portal pill), underline, minimal (accent only), or dot-morph (accent dot → chip on hover)

fields.title: External Link Style
fields.description: underline (default), chip (dimmer tint than internal), minimal (accent only), or dot-morph

fields.title: OpenType Superscript Footnotes
fields.description: uses font-feature-settings: "sups" for native superscript numerals on footnote links

fields.title: Rough Marker Highlight
fields.description: gives ==highlighted== text an organic hand-drawn marker edge via SVG displacement

fields.title: Highlight Color
fields.description: color of ==highlighted== text — also applies to the rough marker when enabled

fields.title: List Indent Guide Color
fields.description: color of the vertical guide lines beside nested lists — applies in both reading and editing modes (default is theme-standard subtle border)

fields.title: Indent Guide — Dashed
fields.description: switch the indent guide line from solid to dashed in both reading and editing modes

fields.title: Disable Balanced Heading Wrap
fields.description: turns off text-wrap balance on headings (escape hatch for browsers where it misbehaves)

fields.title: Teardrop Fold Indicator
fields.description: enables the animated water-drop / circle fold indicator for headings; teardrop hangs point-up (open), morphs to a circle on collapse with physics animation. obsidian's native chevron is used by default.

fields.title: Fold Indicator — Hover to Reveal
fields.description: hide the fold indicator until you hover over a heading; works with both teardrop and the native obsidian indicator

fields.title: Header Size Preset
fields.description: size scale presets — opinionated uses a major-third scale, descending uses a minor-third, flat makes all headers the same size

fields.title: H1 Size (em)
fields.description: custom size in em units; active preset overrides this — clear the preset above to use custom sizes

fields.title: Disable H2 Underline
fields.description: removes the gradient underline from h2 headings

fields.title: H1 Weight
fields.description: nightingale looks best at weight >500

fields.title: Center Canvas Text
fields.description: center align text in canvas cards

fields.title: ⬡ .𖥔 ݁ ˖ Multi-column ⊹ ࣪ ˖
fields.description: Use [!col] with nested >> callouts as columns. Use [!col-strip] as a column to remove chrome from its contents.

fields.title: 📖 .𖥔 ݁ ˖ Usage Reference ⊹ ࣪ ˖
fields.description: quick reference for spans, per-note classes, callouts, and task icons

fields.title: Inline Spans & Marks
fields.description: Use `` or `` directly in note body (works in reading view): `full paragraph text here` → large drop cap on the first letter; remaining text flows normally `text` → small caps (requires a font with OpenType `smcp` glyphs) `hidden text` → hidden behind a bar until hovered; works across multiple lines `==highlighted text==` uses the global highlight color set in Style Settings. For per-mark color overrides use `text`: `ulu-r` red   `ulu-g` green   `ulu-b` blue   `ulu-p` purple   `ulu-o` orange   `ulu-y` yellow

fields.title: Per-note CSS Classes
fields.description:
Add to a note's frontmatter to apply only to that note:
```
---
cssclasses: [ulu-justify, ulu-accent-title]
---
```
`ulu-justify` — justified paragraph text with auto-hyphenation

`ulu-accent-title` — accent-coloured inline note title

`ulu-minimal-properties` — strips slab/border/shadow from the properties block

fields.title: Callouts
fields.description:
**Multi-column layout** — use `[!col]` with `>>` nested callouts as columns:
```
> [!col]
>> First column content here.
>
>> Second column content here.
```
Use `[!col-strip]` as a column type to remove all chrome from its contents.

fields.title: Task List Icons
fields.description:
Custom task types replace the standard checkbox with a coloured icon:

`- [!]` red alert   `- [?]` orange question   `- [i]` blue info
`- [*]` purple star   `- [+]` green add   `- [-]` grey cancelled
`- [b]` orange bookmark   `- ["]` grey quote   `- [l]` red pin
